title: Inertia v3 Server-Side Upgrade — Documentation Phase
description: Produce the planning and migration documentation for upgrading @antennajs/core and @antennajs/adapter-hono from Inertia v2 to Inertia v3.1.x protocol. Hard break from v2; v2-era gaps (error bag, tests, SSR marker) deferred to follow-up tickets. Deliverables: PLAN.md (root), packages/core/V3-MIGRATION.md, packages/adapter-hono/V3-MIGRATION.md, .changeset entries, and README touch-ups. Code changes (Phase A: core protocol, Phase B: adapter) are out of scope for this epic and will follow in a separate session once the docs are merged.

title: Inertia v3 Server-Side Upgrade — Code Implementation Phase
description: Implement the Inertia v3.1.x protocol code changes documented in PLAN.md and the per-package V3-MIGRATION.md guides. Phase A: core protocol changes in @antennajs/core (peer dep bump, Header.REDIRECT, InertiaResponse resolvers, Inertia instance sharedKeys/preserveFragment, DeferProp rescue, InertiaView pageJson). Phase B: adapter fragment-redirect detection in @antennajs/adapter-hono. Both phases end with `pnpm install` + `pnpm build` to verify the packages compile. Tests are NOT in scope (TKT-1, deferred).

title: Phase A: Implement core protocol changes in @antennajs/core
Phase B: Implement fragment-redirect detection in @antennajs/adapter-hono
